CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.broadcast_route_tracking_invalidation(p_tenant_id uuid, p_route_id uuid, p_reason text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_profile_id uuid;
begin
  if p_tenant_id is null then
    return;
  end if;

  perform safebus_private.send_tracking_invalidation(
    'safebus:tenant:' || p_tenant_id::text,
    p_reason
  );

  if p_route_id is null then
    return;
  end if;

  for v_profile_id in
    select distinct g.profile_id
    from public.student_route_assignments sra
    join public.students s
      on s.id = sra.student_id
     and s.tenant_id = sra.tenant_id
     and s.status = 'active'
    join public.student_guardians sg
      on sg.student_id = s.id
     and sg.tenant_id = s.tenant_id
     and sg.status = 'active'
    join public.guardians g
      on g.id = sg.guardian_id
     and g.tenant_id = sg.tenant_id
     and g.status = 'active'
    where sra.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
      and sra.route_id = p_route_id
      and sra.status = 'active'
      and sra.effective_from <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Edmonton')::date)
      and (sra.effective_to is null or sra.effective_to >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Edmonton')::date))
  loop
    perform safebus_private.send_guardian_tracking_invalidation(v_profile_id, p_reason);
  end loop;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.notify_tracking_location_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  perform safebus_private.broadcast_route_tracking_invalidation(
    new.tenant_id,
    new.route_id,
    'location'
  );
  return null;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.send_guardian_tracking_invalidation(p_profile_id uuid, p_reason text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select safebus_private.send_tracking_invalidation(
    'safebus:guardian:' || p_profile_id::text,
    p_reason
  )
  where p_profile_id is not null;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.send_tracking_invalidation(p_topic text, p_reason text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_topic is null or p_reason is null then
    return;
  end if;

  perform realtime.send(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'reason', p_reason,
      'occurred_at', statement_timestamp()
    ),
    'tracking_changed',
    p_topic,
    true
  );
end;
$function$
